mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline ≥0.1% over prior month, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of interaction periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals easing supply constraints and expanding corporate capacity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO growth >0.5% months, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 100,000 signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with PAYEMS rise ≥100k, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RSAFS growth >0.5% and HOUST decline >0.5% from prior month indicate consumption shift toward non-housing sectors, supporting resilient economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of interaction periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.2% monthly signals supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during supply contraction regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO growth <0.2% months, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
